items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: There was Jerry Cooper, myself, Candy Candina, uh, Coco, and, uh, Joe Valenti... And we were all playing in that same place for a dollar and a half a night.

ctx.x: Jerry Cooper, the singer. He's up, uh, he's up in New York. He left in and he never did come back. There was Jerry Cooper, myself, Candy Candina, uh, Coco, and, uh, Joe Valenti. He's playing bass now. And, uh, I don't know who was on the drums at that time. But that was in a spotlight. They had a night club in them days. Cabaret, they called them. That's what they called them in those days. Cabarets. And we were all playing in that same place for a dollar and a half a night. And if we'd have gotten a break that…
Well I think the kids today like to hear melody. I think people still like melody and they like to dance.
